Yes, damaged items are handled differently from normal returns.
Damaged or Defective Items:
When an item arrives damaged or has a manufacturing defect, you can qualify for a replacement instead of going through the standard return process. Returns due to verified manufacturing defects are eligible for a full refund or replacement, including shipping fees, under our warranty. The team reviews your documentation and determines the best solution — which could be a repair, replacement, or return.
Normal Returns:
Standard returns (for reasons other than damage or defects) are subject to our regular return policy, which includes trial periods, restocking fees for certain items like furniture, and other conditions depending on the product type.
The key difference is that damage caused by Avocado's manufacturing or logistics teams is treated as a quality issue, not a preference-based return — so you won't face restocking fees or other standard return limitations.
